name: Emperor Sui-Nin (Part Vii. His Death And That Of The Empress Hibasu.)

verses: This Heavenly Sovereign's august years were one hundred and fifty-three. His august mausoleum is in the middle of the moor of Mitachi at Sugahara. Again in the time of the Great Empress Her Augustness Princess Hibasu, the Stone-Coffin-Makers were established, and also the Earthenware-Masters' Clan was established. This Empress was buried in the mausoleum of Terama near Saki.
